blocks.text: HOW THE NEW BIOME LOCATIONS RELATE TO THE WORLD TRADITIONS

The Basalt Memory Coast, Salt Mirror Archive, Marble Dune Cemetery, Glacial Memory Fjord, Redwood Rain Vault, Museum of Unfinished Rooms, River of Deferred Reflections, and Valley That Restores Wrong explore different ways a landscape can preserve history. They form a spectrum from ordered strata and intentional seasonal access to excess backup, confused restoration, and records separated from provenance.

The Coral Data Labyrinth, Kelp Tower Shelf, Fulgurite Savannah, Cloudroot Tepuis, Mangrove Cathedral, Blackwater Canopy, Redwood Rain Vault, Bamboo Signal Sea, Floating Peat Islands, Tundra Bloom Circuit, and Obsidian Mangrove Delta emphasize succession, migration, predation, seasonal change, and new ecology. Their living growth should never be treated automatically as corruption merely because it covers ancient infrastructure.

The Red Glass Erg, Copper Canyon Chorus, Volcanic Orchard Caldera, Orchard of Borrowed Moons, Monsoon Stepwell City, City of Rainward Roofs, Ice Cave of Paused Dawn, and Stormwall Orchard use law, climate, agriculture, sound, water, or light as collaborative art. Their failures arise when a designed relationship is frozen, optimized for one use, or inherited without its interpretive grammar.

The Inland Sea of Doors, Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Alpine Bell Pass, Karst Lantern Provinces, Stair of Thin Air, Urban Canyon Hive, Skyfold Boundary, and Plain of Missing Distance make travel transformative. Routes teach body limits, consent, language, acclimation, and dependence. A shortcut can be a cultural loss if it removes the learning that once made arrival safe.

The Salt Mirror Archive, Cloudroot Tepuis, Glacial Memory Fjord, Karst Lantern Provinces, Redwood Rain Vault, Inverted Rainforest, Floating Peat Islands, Tundra Bloom Circuit, Ice Cave of Paused Dawn, and River of Deferred Reflections limit access through season, ecology, darkness, distance, cold, or uncertainty. Their secrecy is not automatically hostile; restricted observation can protect slow life and prevent preserved memories from being forced into constant social presence.

The Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Karst Lantern Provinces, Monsoon Stepwell City, Urban Canyon Hive, City of Rainward Roofs, Museum of Unfinished Rooms, and Mosaic Worldscar become places through exchange among unlike inhabitants. Their strongest visual theme is not mixture alone but infrastructure that permits difference to remain functional: body-specific streets, shared water, translation ecologies, seasonal markets, and visibly negotiated seams.
